scientific_integrity: Explicit proof of the best-response contraction and edge-cover/coloring count, independently checked by exhaustive direct-payoff and local-rule programs; no independent external validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Unit-payoff conformists/rebels on undirected simple cycles with n>=3, m>=3, at least one rebel, no stubborn vertices. Unindexed equivalent formulas may exist; no claim of absolute literature novelty. Computation verifies finite cases while the proof treats all finite parameters.
title: Exact pure-equilibrium census of heterogeneous conformist–rebel cycles
